test_Bytecode_ContainsNoDelegatecallOrSe.details: A naive byte scan is WRONG here and my first version of this test failed because of it:      0xff and 0xf4 occur constantly inside PUSH immediates (constants, selectors, the trailing      CBOR metadata hash) where they are data, not instructions. Opcodes are only meaningful at      instruction boundaries, so this walks the bytecode properly, stepping over the immediate      data of every PUSH1..PUSH32. Anything less is a test that passes or fails by luck.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).
